{{Quote|Our security has been compromised. An analysis of the data banks where that file was stored indicated that the only times it had been accessed in recent years was when automated backup programming refreshed it and compared it with static stored copies. Military programmers could find no other signs of intrusion, so I requested assistance from Intelligence, which revealed the method used&hellip;|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>}}
'''''Three seven nine aitch oh ell forty-four underscore bee nine two one''''' (379HOL44_B921)was a high-level, extremely classified access code reserved for use by the upper echelons of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]]. At the bottom of the unassigned list, ''three seven nine aitch oh ell forty-four underscore bee nine two one'' had been all but forgotten about by GAG personnel until it was secretly stolen and used to infiltrate the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]]'s systems by [[Lumiya]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]].
